base_results.summary: Every file is safe to read.
The fee receipt is attached and valid.
A finished-product stability report is included.
The reference approval is from a reference country and still valid.
No foreign suspension or withdrawal was found.
A person must confirm the product is the same: the shelf life is 36 months here and 24 months in the reference approval.
Long-term stability data is at 25 C / 60% RH for 12 months. The rule asks for 30 C / 65% RH.
The English leaflet gives 500 mg twice a day. The Arabic leaflet gives 1000 mg twice a day.
The establishment licence is given, but it does not name the marketing authorisation holder.
The PV summary says the qualified person is named in section 2, but no name is shown.
